known_skeleton_mismatch: Source skeleton has no Hips bone; Spine1 is only a pelvis proxy and must not be assumed equivalent without pose inspection.
Source skeleton has no LeftUpLeg or RightUpLeg; LeftLeg and RightLeg are candidate thigh mappings.
Source hierarchy contains limbs that are independent roots; target parent relationships must be checked before retargeting.
The mapping is name-based and has not been validated against target rest orientations or rendered poses.
required_validation_before_render_releas: Inspect source and target rest poses in the same coordinate frame.
Determine FBX axis convention and unit scale from measured landmarks; do not infer from bone names.
Measure target/source bone direction vectors and define per-bone rest-pose correction.
Define root translation and root-motion policy explicitly.
Run a neutral-pose retarget and reject flipped, collapsed, or disconnected joints.
Render a contact sheet for start, midpoint, end, and high-motion frames.
For weightlifting_press_overhead, verify wrist/bar contact, symmetric grip, elbow path, shoulder range, bar clearance, and foot contact.
Run loop-seam and joint-continuity checks on the final rendered media.
Keep status non-production until visual technique review passes for each intended character presentation.

release_policy.reason: This manifest records an audited candidate mapping only. It does not implement retargeting and must never be treated as a completed animation or as proof of biomechanical correctness.
